text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Hah, whew... Yeah, feeling good!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah. I study all kinds of dances to 
help build my persona, so this much is 
only natural. ...By the way.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
—Did you need something from me, Yukino 
Bijin-san?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hyek! Y-You figured it out...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for peekin' in like that... Your 
dance was just so cool, Royce-san, I 
couldn't help starin'...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Um, Royce-san! I know this is sudden 
and I'm really sorry to impose, but could 
I ask you for a favor?!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ah... the dance class recital, right? I 
certainly have experience with that too.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
All the other girls in class can dance 
with such cool, urban style. And yet, I...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That's why, please, Royce! Could you teach 
me how to do those city dances?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind, but... the recital is 
freestyle, right? In that case, you have a 
dance you excel at, don't you, Yukino-san?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
A traditional dance whose charm lies in 
dynamic movements reminiscent of the 
breath of majestic nature.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehh?! No way, no way. I mean, sure, I 
could dance it with my eyes closed, but 
that's not something meant for a 
recital...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, so that's what you meant by 'city 
dance.' ...I understand now, Yukino-san!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
In that case, this ace producer, Royce and 
Royce-chan, will give you the ultimate 
producer treatment!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's dance, Yukino-san! Hurry up 
and get onto the platform!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
E-Eeeek! This is a dance game, right? I'm 
not really used to this kind of thing!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Well said, Trainer-san. Now, we've already 
picked the song, so it's time to brace 
yourself, Yukino-san!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, whoaaa~... I'm gonna get swept away by 
the rough waves of the big city~!

text_block_list.name: Customer A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! That glasses-wearing horse girl is 
insanely good!

text_block_list.name: Customer B
text_block_list.text:
The girl dancing with her... is she not 
used to this? ...No, wait, could it be?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
E-Eeeek... T-This is so hard~! I guess 
city dancing really isn't for me...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
You think so? Even with all that, 
Yukino-san, didn't you do it all without a 
single mistake?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...C-Come to think of it. This is 
supposed to be my first time doing it, so 
why did... Ah."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Right, the song and tempo are totally 
different, but this footwork is the one I 
always used to dance to, that—"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
With this, even I can...! Hup! Haa! Seii! 
Toryaaa!

text_block_list.name: Customer A & Customer B
text_block_list.text:
"A-Awesome! That was way too cool!" "A new 
dance queen has been born!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Splendid, Yukino-san! That was a 
magnificent dance!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
*Haa, fuu*... I-Is it really gonna be me 
singing that song...? I still can't 
believe it...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Do you understand now? You didn't need to 
search outside for your charm—it was 
within you all along!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Do you understand now? You didn't need to 
search outside for your charm—it was 
within you all along!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you. I'm feeling pretty good, 
so why don't we keep dancing a bit longer, 
Yukino-san?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes! I look forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Royce and Royce and Yukino 
Bijin tackled a variety of songs, 
polishing their dancing skills.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Thank ye kindly! I dunno how I can ever 
repay this favor—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Oh, then won't you teach me next time? 
I've really wanted to learn the dance from 
your hometown properly.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah, yes! If you're okay with me, I'd 
love to!
